text_simplified: Parents must raise their children upon the love of Allah and obedience to Him, and teach them good akhlaq and upright conduct. They should also instill religious values in the hearts of children from a young age, so they may be righteous in this world and the Hereafter. Giving attention to imani tarbiyah helps build a balanced personality for the child.

review_defects.english: The Importance of Tarbiyah and Akhlaq for Children
review_defects.why: The Arabic specifies 'religious and moral education' (التربية الدينية والأخلاقية), but the English title reduces this to generic 'Tarbiyah and Akhlaq', omitting the qualifiers 'religious' and 'moral' and thus changing the meaning.
The Arabic uses plain language 'faith-based upbringing', but the English uses transliterated Islamic jargon 'imani tarbiyah', which is less direct and may be unclear to general readers.
'نفوس' means souls/self, not specifically hearts; 'hearts' is a slight semantic shift.
